column4: Generalized clones never boot (cold boots hang too). Depends on L-2 arms A and B.

Invalid as designed: removing guest-tools drivers from the running image left it unbootable (Your device ran into a problem and could not be repaired, 005) before sysprep ran. Arm B (image that never had the tools) is the deciding test.

Generalized image boots on Homebrew QEMU 11.1.2 with no hang: guest agent answered with a new hostname 60 s after sysprep's reboot, region screen shown. The hang is in UTM 4.7.5's QEMU/edk2, not Windows.

doWipePersistProvisionedData, called locally through the MDM WMI bridge, reset the generalized VM and Windows booted back to the region screen in 11.5 minutes on Homebrew QEMU. First post-reset boot in this lab.
Stopped during the install: superseded by L-2C, which showed the hang is UTM QEMU/edk2, so the guest tools question no longer matters.
